# DataFill

> Free online text toolkit: lorem ipsum generation, character / word / line
> counter, case conversion, Base64 and text diff, plus fake name, email,
> address, phone and password generation. No sign-up, runs locally in the
> browser. Available in English and Turkish.

- Homepage: https://datafill.vercel.app/
- Sitemap: https://datafill.vercel.app/sitemap.xml

## Tools

- Lorem ipsum generation by exact character count (options: no spaces, no special characters)
- Character, word and line counter
- Case converter (upper, lower, title, slug)
- Sort and dedupe lines
- Whitespace cleaner
- Base64 encode and decode
- Text diff (before / after)
- Secure password generator (random or wordlist)
- Fake data: full name, email, address, phone, UUID, date, TCKN, IBAN, VKN,
  licence plate, username, company, job title, credit card (test), slug, color,
  IPv4, IPv6, MAC, coordinates, hash, barcode, boolean, sentence, paragraph
- Dataset builder (JSON, CSV, SQL export)
